title: Gravitas Task Contract
description: Machine-readable task contract for Gravitas v4. Defines mode, objective, acceptance criteria, scope and budget.

mode.description: Execution mode. Read-only modes (answer/research/plan-only/review-only/security-review) block all write operations at hook level.

objective.description: Plain-language description of what this task should accomplish.

acceptance_criteria.description: Verifiable outcomes. Structured entries bind a stable criterion ID to its statement and validator IDs; strings remain supported for v4 compatibility.

non_goals.description: Explicit non-goals. Used to prevent scope creep.

budget.description: Orchestration budget profile. Controls recon depth, delegation threshold, and verification scope.

allowed_write_scope.description: File paths or directory prefixes where writes are permitted. Empty array means full repository scope. PreToolUse hook enforces this.

verification.description: Verification scope. Targeted: run tests for changed modules only. Affected: run all tests for changed and dependent modules. Full: complete test suite.

required_validators.description: Legacy command-fragment migration field. Prefer named validators, which bind completion to Gravitas-owned exit-code records.

validators.description: Named validators for Gravitas-owned execution. Completion accepts only their captured exit-code records.

task_id.description: Optional unique ID for session ledger path. Auto-generated if not provided.
